import argparse
import asyncio
import json
from .store import Store
from .scheduler import submit
from .worker import work
from .export import export_bundle
from .resources import provenance


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Agent Arena Local")
    parser.add_argument("--db", default="runtime/arena.sqlite")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for command in ("submit", "demo"):
        sub = commands.add_parser(command)
        sub.add_argument("--config", default="configs/simulated.json")
        sub.add_argument("--tasks", default="data/tasks.jsonl")
        if command == "demo":
            sub.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    worker = commands.add_parser("worker")
    worker.add_argument("--once", action="store_true", help="Drena la cola disponible y termina")
    export = commands.add_parser("export")
    export.add_argument("experiment_id")
    export.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    cancel = commands.add_parser("cancel")
    cancel.add_argument("run_id")
    commands.add_parser("status")
    commands.add_parser("hardware")
    recover = commands.add_parser("recover")
    recover.add_argument("--workers-stopped", action="store_true", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    store = Store(args.db)
    if args.command in {"submit", "demo"}:
        experiment_id = submit(store, args.config, args.tasks)
        print(experiment_id)
        if args.command == "demo":
            asyncio.run(work(store, once=True))
            export_bundle(store, experiment_id, args.output)
    elif args.command == "worker":
        asyncio.run(work(store, once=args.once))
    elif args.command == "export":
        export_bundle(store, args.experiment_id, args.output)
    elif args.command == "cancel":
        store.cancel(args.run_id)
    elif args.command == "recover":
        store.recover()
    elif args.command == "hardware":
        print(json.dumps(provenance(), indent=2))
    elif args.command == "status":
        print(json.dumps(store.list_runs(), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


class Contract(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class Limits(Contract):
    timeout_s: float = Field(default=120, gt=0, le=3600)
    max_calls: int = Field(default=12, ge=1, le=100)
    max_tool_calls: int = Field(default=30, ge=0, le=300)
    max_output_tokens: int = Field(default=4096, ge=1, le=65536)


class AgentConfig(Contract):
    model: str = Field(min_length=1)
    system_prompt: str = Field(min_length=1)
    temperature: float = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=2)
    seed: int | None = 42
    num_ctx: int = Field(default=8192, ge=512)
    limits: Limits = Field(default_factory=Limits)


class Criteria(Contract):
    total_cents: int = Field(ge=0)
    order_ids: list[str]
    allowed_tools: list[str] = ["search_orders", "order_lines", "calculate"]


class Task(Contract):
    id: str
    split: Literal["dev", "eval"]
    input: str
    environment: str
    criteria: Criteria


class Experiment(Contract):
    name: str
    adapter: Literal["simulated", "ollama"] = "simulated"
    mode: Literal["sequential"] = "sequential"
    agents: dict[str, AgentConfig]
    split: Literal["dev", "eval"] = "dev"
    repetitions: int = Field(default=1, ge=1, le=100)
    order_seed: int = 42
    ollama_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def paired_model(self):
        if set(self.agents) != {"A", "B"}:
            raise ValueError("Se requieren exactamente las ramas A y B")
        if self.agents["A"].model != self.agents["B"].model:
            raise ValueError("El primer hito compara el mismo modelo")
        return self


Status = Literal["queued", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "timeout", "limit", "cancelled", "interrupted"]


class Run(Contract):
    id: str
    experiment_id: str
    task_id: str
    branch: Literal["A", "B"]
    repetition: int
    position: int
    status: Status = "queued"
    queued_at: float
    started_at: float | None = None
    finished_at: float | None = None
    result: dict | None = None


class Event(Contract):
    run_id: str
    kind: str
    at: float
    payload: dict


class ResourceSample(Contract):
    at: float
    scope: Literal["host_and_worker"] = "host_and_worker"
    ram_available_bytes: int | None = None
    worker_rss_bytes: int | None = None
    gpu: list[dict] | None = None
    unavailable: list[str] = []

import csv
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import binomtest


FIELDS = ["id", "experiment_id", "task_id", "branch", "repetition", "position", "status", "adapter",
          "success", "format_ok", "queue_s", "agent_s", "input_tokens", "output_tokens", "usage_complete",
          "calls", "tool_calls", "tool_errors", "tool_s", "server_eval_s", "server_tps", "agent_output_tps", "error"]


def csv_text(store, experiment_id):
    adapter = store.snapshot(experiment_id)["config"]["adapter"]
    output = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=FIELDS, extrasaction="ignore")
    writer.writeheader()
    for run in store.list_runs(experiment_id):
        writer.writerow(run | {"adapter": adapter} | (run["result"] or {}))
    return output.getvalue()


def paired_summary(store, experiment_id):
    runs = store.list_runs(experiment_id)
    if any(r["status"] in {"queued", "running"} for r in runs):
        raise ValueError("Finaliza o cancela las ejecuciones antes de analizar")
    frame = pd.DataFrame([{**r, "success": int((r["result"] or {}).get("success", False))} for r in runs])
    pairs = frame.pivot(index=["task_id", "repetition"], columns="branch", values="success")
    wins_a = int(((pairs.A == 1) & (pairs.B == 0)).sum())
    wins_b = int(((pairs.B == 1) & (pairs.A == 0)).sum())
    # Repetitions are clustered by task; avoid treating them as independent observations.
    repeats = store.snapshot(experiment_id)["config"]["repetitions"]
    p_value = binomtest(wins_a, wins_a + wins_b).pvalue if wins_a + wins_b and repeats == 1 else None
    return {"pairs": len(pairs), "success_rate": frame.groupby("branch").success.mean().to_dict(),
            "A_only_success": wins_a, "B_only_success": wins_b, "mcnemar_exact_p": p_value,
            "note": "Descriptive results; p omitted with repetitions or no discordant pairs. Synthetic tasks are not a population sample."}


def export_bundle(store, experiment_id, directory):
    summary = paired_summary(store, experiment_id)
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (directory / "metrics.csv").write_text(csv_text(store, experiment_id), encoding="utf-8")
    runs = store.list_runs(experiment_id)
    (directory / "snapshot.json").write_text(json.dumps(store.snapshot(experiment_id), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    (directory / "runs.json").write_text(json.dumps(runs, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    with (directory / "events.jsonl").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
        for run in runs:
            for event in store.events(run["id"]):
                file.write(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    (directory / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

import asyncio
import copy
import json
import time
import httpx
from .evaluator import evaluate
from .tools import Tools
from .resources import sample


class LimitReached(Exception):
    pass


class Cancelled(Exception):
    pass


async def execute(run, task, environment, config, adapter, store):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    tools = Tools(environment)
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": config.system_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": task.input}]
    names = []
    metrics = {"success": False, "format_ok": False, "queue_s": max(0, run["started_at"] - run["queued_at"]),
               "input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0, "server_eval_s": 0., "calls": 0,
               "tool_calls": 0, "tool_errors": 0, "tool_s": 0., "usage_complete": True}
    store.event(run["id"], "input", {"messages": messages, "environment": environment})
    store.event(run["id"], "resources", sample())

    async def checked(awaitable):
        pending = asyncio.create_task(awaitable)
        try:
            while not pending.done():
                if store.cancelled(run["id"]):
                    raise Cancelled()
                await asyncio.wait({pending}, timeout=0.1)
            return await pending
        finally:
            if not pending.done():
                pending.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(pending, return_exceptions=True)

    async def loop():
        metadata = await checked(adapter.metadata(config.model))
        store.event(run["id"], "inference_metadata", metadata)
        for _ in range(config.limits.max_calls):
            if store.cancelled(run["id"]):
                raise Cancelled()
            remaining = config.limits.max_output_tokens - metrics["output_tokens"]
            if remaining <= 0:
                raise LimitReached("output_tokens")
            metrics["calls"] += 1
            store.event(run["id"], "inference_request", {"messages": copy.deepcopy(messages), "max_output_tokens": remaining})
            call_start = time.perf_counter()
            try:
                response = await checked(adapter.chat(copy.deepcopy(messages), config, remaining))
            except BaseException:
                metrics["usage_complete"] = False
                raise
            message = response["message"]
            store.event(run["id"], "inference_response", {"response": response, "duration_s": time.perf_counter() - call_start})
            if not all(k in response for k in ("prompt_eval_count", "eval_count", "eval_duration")):
                metrics["usage_complete"] = False
                raise ValueError("Missing inference usage counters")
            if any(type(response[k]) is not int or response[k] < 0 for k in ("prompt_eval_count", "eval_count", "eval_duration")):
                metrics["usage_complete"] = False
                raise ValueError("Invalid inference usage counters")
            metrics["input_tokens"] += response["prompt_eval_count"]
            metrics["output_tokens"] += response["eval_count"]
            metrics["server_eval_s"] += response["eval_duration"] / 1e9
            if response.get("done") is not True:
                raise ValueError("Incomplete server response")
            if response.get("done_reason") == "length" or metrics["output_tokens"] > config.limits.max_output_tokens:
                raise LimitReached("output_tokens")
            messages.append(message)
            calls = message.get("tool_calls") or []
            if not calls:
                metrics["answer"] = message.get("content", "")
                metrics.update(evaluate(metrics["answer"], task, names))
                return "succeeded" if metrics["success"] else "failed"
            for call in calls:
                if store.cancelled(run["id"]):
                    raise Cancelled()
                if metrics["tool_calls"] >= config.limits.max_tool_calls:
                    raise LimitReached("tool_calls")
                function = call["function"]
                name, arguments = function["name"], function["arguments"]
                names.append(name)
                metrics["tool_calls"] += 1
                tool_start = time.perf_counter()
                store.event(run["id"], "tool_request", {"name": name, "arguments": arguments})
                error = None
                try:
                    result = tools.call(name, arguments)
                except Exception as exc:
                    error = str(exc)
                    metrics["tool_errors"] += 1
                    result = {"error": error}
                duration = time.perf_counter() - tool_start
                metrics["tool_s"] += duration
                store.event(run["id"], "tool_result", {"name": name, "result": result, "error": error, "duration_s": duration})
                messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_name": name, "content": json.dumps(result)})
        raise LimitReached("model_calls")

    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(config.limits.timeout_s):
            status = await loop()
    except (TimeoutError, httpx.TimeoutException) as exc:
        status, metrics["error"] = "timeout", type(exc).__name__
    except LimitReached as exc:
        status, metrics["error"] = "limit", str(exc)
    except Cancelled:
        status, metrics["error"] = "cancelled", "Cancelled by user"
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        status, metrics["error"] = "interrupted", "Worker interrupted"
    except Exception as exc:
        status, metrics["error"] = "failed", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    metrics["agent_s"] = time.perf_counter() - started
    metrics["server_tps"] = metrics["output_tokens"] / metrics["server_eval_s"] if metrics["server_eval_s"] and metrics["usage_complete"] else None
    metrics["agent_output_tps"] = metrics["output_tokens"] / metrics["agent_s"] if metrics["usage_complete"] else None
    store.event(run["id"], "resources", sample())
    return store.finish(run, metrics, status)

import hashlib
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from .contracts import Experiment, Task, Run
from .resources import provenance


def submit(store, config_path, tasks_path):
    config_path, tasks_path = Path(config_path), Path(tasks_path)
    config = Experiment.model_validate_json(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if config.adapter == "ollama" and os.environ.get("ARENA_OLLAMA_URL"):
        config.ollama_url = os.environ["ARENA_OLLAMA_URL"]
    tasks = [Task.model_validate_json(line) for line in tasks_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if len({t.id for t in tasks}) != len(tasks):
        raise ValueError("Identificadores de tareas duplicados")
    tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.split == config.split]
    if not tasks:
        raise ValueError("No hay tareas para el split seleccionado")
    environments = {t.environment: json.loads((tasks_path.parent / t.environment).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for t in tasks}
    code_files = list(Path(__file__).parent.glob("*.py"))
    try:
        git = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        commit = git.stdout.strip() or None
    except FileNotFoundError:
        commit = None
    snapshot = {"config": config.model_dump(), "tasks": [t.model_dump() for t in tasks],
                "environments": environments, "host": provenance(), "git_commit": commit,
                "source_sha256": {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in code_files},
                "source": {p.name: p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in code_files},
                "conditions": {"mode": "sequential", "warmup": "none", "keep_alive": "5m", "resource_scope": "host_and_worker", "seed_determinism": "not guaranteed"}}
    snapshot["data_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({"tasks": snapshot["tasks"], "environments": environments}, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    experiment_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    rng, runs = random.Random(config.order_seed), []
    for repetition in range(config.repetitions):
        for task in tasks:
            branches = ["A", "B"]
            rng.shuffle(branches)
            for branch in branches:
                runs.append(Run(id=str(uuid.uuid4()), experiment_id=experiment_id, task_id=task.id,
                                branch=branch, repetition=repetition, position=len(runs), queued_at=time.time()))
    store.create(experiment_id, snapshot, runs)
    return experiment_id

import json
import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from .contracts import Event


class Store:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = str(path)
        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.executescript("""
                PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS experiments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL);
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs(
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, experiment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES experiments(id),
                    position INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL,
                    cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events(
                    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
                    kind TEXT NOT NULL, at REAL NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL);
                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_run ON events(run_id, seq);
            """)

    @contextmanager
    def connect(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=30) as db:
            db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            db.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
            yield db

    def create(self, experiment_id, snapshot, runs):
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("INSERT INTO experiments VALUES (?,?)", (experiment_id, json.dumps(snapshot)))
            for run in runs:
                db.execute("INSERT INTO runs(id,experiment_id,position,status,data) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                           (run.id, experiment_id, run.position, run.status, run.model_dump_json()))

    def snapshot(self, experiment_id):
        with self.connect() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT snapshot FROM experiments WHERE id=?", (experiment_id,)).fetchone()
            if not row:
                raise KeyError(experiment_id)
            return json.loads(row[0])

    def list_runs(self, experiment_id=None):
        with self.connect() as db:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT data FROM runs " + ("WHERE experiment_id=? " if experiment_id else "") +
                              "ORDER BY rowid", (experiment_id,) if experiment_id else ()).fetchall()
            return [json.loads(r[0]) for r in rows]

    def list_experiments(self, limit=50):
        with self.connect() as db:
            rows = db.execute("""
                SELECT e.id, json_extract(e.snapshot, '$.config.name') AS name,
                       json_extract(e.snapshot, '$.config.adapter') AS adapter,
                       json_extract(e.snapshot, '$.config.split') AS split,
                       COUNT(r.id) AS total,
                       SUM(CASE WHEN r.status NOT IN ('queued','running') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed,
                       MIN(json_extract(r.data, '$.queued_at')) AS created_at
                FROM experiments e LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.experiment_id=e.id
                GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY e.rowid DESC LIMIT ?
            """, (limit,)).fetchall()
            return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    def claim(self):
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            # A single active run globally preserves sequential resource conditions even with two workers.
            if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE status='running'").fetchone():
                return None
            row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM runs WHERE status='queued' ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1").fetchone()
            if not row:
                return None
            run = json.loads(row["data"])
            run.update(status="running", started_at=time.time())
            db.execute("UPDATE runs SET status='running',data=? WHERE id=?", (json.dumps(run), run["id"]))
            return run

    def event(self, run_id, kind, payload):
        event = Event(run_id=run_id, kind=kind, payload=payload, at=time.time())
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("INSERT INTO events(run_id,kind,at,payload) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                       (event.run_id, event.kind, event.at, json.dumps(event.payload)))

    def events(self, run_id):
        with self.connect() as db:
            return [dict(row) | {"payload": json.loads(row["payload"])} for row in
                    db.execute("SELECT * FROM events WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY seq", (run_id,))]

    def cancelled(self, run_id):
        with self.connect() as db:
            return bool(db.execute("SELECT cancel_requested FROM runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()[0])

    def cancel(self, run_id):
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            row = db.execute("SELECT data,status FROM runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
            if not row:
                raise KeyError(run_id)
            if row["status"] == "queued":
                run = json.loads(row["data"])
                run.update(status="cancelled", finished_at=time.time(), result={"success": False, "format_ok": False, "error": "Cancelled before execution"})
                db.execute("UPDATE runs SET status='cancelled',data=?,cancel_requested=1 WHERE id=?", (json.dumps(run), run_id))
            elif row["status"] == "running":
                db.execute("UPDATE runs SET cancel_requested=1 WHERE id=?", (run_id,))
        self.event(run_id, "cancel_requested", {})

    def finish(self, run, result, status):
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            row = db.execute("SELECT status,cancel_requested FROM runs WHERE id=?", (run["id"],)).fetchone()
            if row["status"] != "running":
                return row["status"]
            if row["cancel_requested"]:
                status = "cancelled"
                result.update(success=False, error="Cancelled")
            run.update(status=status, finished_at=time.time(), result=result)
            db.execute("UPDATE runs SET status=?,data=? WHERE id=?", (status, json.dumps(run), run["id"]))
            db.execute("INSERT INTO events(run_id,kind,at,payload) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                       (run["id"], "finished", run["finished_at"], json.dumps({"status": status, **result})))
            return status

    def recover(self):
        """Explicit recovery only: caller must have stopped all workers first."""
        for run in self.list_runs():
            if run["status"] == "running":
                self.event(run["id"], "interruption", {"reason": "Manual recovery after worker loss"})
                self.finish(run, {"success": False, "format_ok": False, "error": "Worker interrupted; partial metrics in events"}, "interrupted")

import asyncio
from .adapters import Ollama, Simulated
from .contracts import Experiment, Task
from .runner import execute


async def work(store, once=False):
    while True:
        run = store.claim()
        if run is None:
            if once:
                return
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
            continue
        snapshot = store.snapshot(run["experiment_id"])
        config = Experiment.model_validate(snapshot["config"])
        task = next(Task.model_validate(t) for t in snapshot["tasks"] if t["id"] == run["task_id"])
        adapter = Simulated() if config.adapter == "simulated" else Ollama(config.ollama_url)
        status = await execute(run, task, snapshot["environments"][task.environment], config.agents[run["branch"]], adapter, store)
        if status == "interrupted":
            return
